SELECT mi.id AS batchId, mi.material_batch_no AS batchNo, mi.supplier_name AS supplierName, mi.supplier_code AS supplierCode, mi.material_code AS materialCode, mi.material_name AS materialName, mi.spec_model AS specModel, CASE WHEN mi.inspection_result = '不合格' THEN '异常' WHEN mi.review_status = '待审核' AND mi.inspection_result IS NULL THEN '待检' WHEN mi.review_status = '待审核' AND mi.inspection_result IS NOT NULL THEN '在检' ELSE '已检' END AS iqcStatus, mi.inspection_result AS inspectionResult, TO_CHAR(mi.arrival_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS arrivalDate, mi.qualified_qty AS qty, mi.defect_desc AS defectDesc FROM qms.material_inspection mi WHERE mi.is_deleted = 0 AND mi.id IN
#{id}

SELECT mi_stats.total_batches AS totalBatches, mi_stats.qualified_batches AS qualifiedBatches, mi_stats.abnormal_batches AS abnormalBatches, mi_stats.in_check_batches AS inCheckBatches, ROUND( CASE WHEN mi_stats.total_batches = 0 THEN 0 ELSE mi_stats.qualified_batches * 100.0 / mi_stats.total_batches END, 2 ) AS passRate, CASE WHEN COALESCE(mi_stats.total_submitted, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(mi_stats.total_unqualified, 0) * 1000000.0 / mi_stats.total_submitted, 0) END AS ppm, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qms.supplier WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND plant_code = #{plantCode}) AS supplierCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qms.item_node WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND plant_code = #{plantCode} AND node_type = 'SN') AS snCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qms.item_node WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND plant_code = #{plantCode}) AS nodeCount FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_batches, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE inspection_result = '合格') AS qualified_batches, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE inspection_result = '不合格') AS abnormal_batches, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_status = '待审核' AND inspection_result IS NULL) AS in_check_batches, COALESCE(SUM(submitted_qty), 0) AS total_submitted, COALESCE(SUM(unqualified_qty), 0) AS total_unqualified FROM qms.material_inspection WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND plant_code = #{plantCode} ) mi_stats
